name: Ichihara Chiharu
source:
Sweet, caring, and a pro-homecook Chiharu is everything you would want in a childhood friend. Though she was raised sheltered and with a silver spoon in her mouth, Chiharu is not at all spoiled. Shy, a bit naive and craving for companionship due to a lonely lifestyle, Chiharu is always eager to please and always forgets about herself in order to help other people. She does love gossip however, and can be quite the fashionista (with lots of pastel, of course!)

As she is given a second chance to amend her regrets, will the timid Chiharu have the guts to see it through till the end? That remains for you to decide.

[From [url=https://flutteringabyss.itch.io/missingtime]Itch.io[/url]]
